remarks: This move-in-ready 3-bedroom, 1-bath home offers an inviting blend of modern updates, functional living space, and a spacious backyard. Step inside to an open-concept main level featuring a generously sized living room that flows seamlessly into the updated kitchen, complete with abundant cabinetry, a stylish tile backsplash, a center island with butcher block countertops, and plenty of room for entertaining. Upstairs, you'll find three comfortable bedrooms and a full bathroom, providing a practical layout for families, first-time buyers, or anyone looking for extra space. The basement offers ample storage along with laundry and mechanicals. Outside, enjoy a deep backyard with mature trees that provide shade and privacy—perfect for relaxing, gardening, entertaining, or creating your own outdoor retreat. The covered front porch adds to the home's curb appeal and offers a welcoming place to unwind. Conveniently located near schools, parks, shopping, restaurants, and just minutes from the attractions of Niagara Falls, this home is an excellent opportunity for an owner-occupant or investor alike.
